title: Unique one-sided K-flat tensor comparison normalized by two-sided descent
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be a site small in the module universe [def-weil-size-convention] and $B$ a sheaf of commutative rings, with module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $K(B)$ be their homotopy category and $Q:K(B)\to D(B)$ localization at quasi-isomorphisms [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $\mathcal P_B$ be the full subcategory of K-flat complexes [def-pc-kflat-complex] with flat terms [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules]. Use total tensor [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves] and fix the derived tensor and its specified two-sided comparison from [lem-weil-pbc-site-derived-tensor-descent], written
$$\delta_{T,V}:Q\operatorname{Tot}(T\otimes_B V)\xrightarrow{\sim}QT\otimes_B^{\mathbf L}QV\quad(T,V\in\mathcal P_B).$$
For every $T\in\mathcal P_B$, both total tensor functors with fixed factor $T$ preserve quasi-isomorphisms of arbitrary complexes. There is a unique family of isomorphisms
$$c_{T,M}:QT\otimes_B^{\mathbf L}QM\xrightarrow{\sim}Q\operatorname{Tot}(T\otimes_B M)\quad(T\in\mathcal P_B,\ M\in K(B))$$
which is natural in $M$ and satisfies $c_{T,V}=\delta_{T,V}^{-1}$ for every $V\in\mathcal P_B$. This family is also natural in every homotopy-category map $T\to T'$ between objects of $\mathcal P_B$. Explicitly, for every homotopy-category map $f:M\to M'$,
$$Q(1_T\otimes f)\,c_{T,M}=c_{T,M'}(1_{QT}\otimes^{\mathbf L}Qf),$$
and for every $g:T\to T'$,
$$Q(g\otimes1_M)\,c_{T,M}=c_{T',M}(Qg\otimes^{\mathbf L}1_{QM}).$$
Here composition is written right to left. In particular the first equation holds for every K-flat flat-term resolution $V\to M$ and determines the comparison from its specified two-sided normalization. The analogous assertion for $M\otimes_B T$ holds with normalization supplied by the same two-sided comparison in that order; the chain symmetry interchanging factors has component $x\otimes y\mapsto(-1)^{ij}y\otimes x$ in bidegree $(i,j)$. The complex $M$ need not be K-flat, termwise flat, or bounded.
